title: Glowing 'cauldron' of new stars | Space photo of the day for Oct. 26, 2026
caption:
The James Webb Space Telescope has captured a stunning look at N159, a massive star-forming region in a satellite galaxy. This nursery provides a rare glimpse into how stars ignited in the early universe.

Source: Space - Glowing 'cauldron' of new stars | Space photo of the day for Oct. 26, 2026
